errata.error: UHSLC stamps its Hong Kong (Quarry Bay) hourly heights an hour early in every version and the fast-delivery series: the height labeled T was measured at T + 1 h UTC (tide-database#360, confirmed by the clock check).
errata.lake: Every value is moved an hour later.
errata.evidence: Found in tide-database#360 and confirmed by `scripts/clock-check.ts`: Quarry Bay fits other records best an hour later, in every version and the fast-delivery series.
errata.report: Sent to srdata@soest.hawaii.edu on 2026-10-24, with a follow-up on 2026-11-07. No answer yet.

errata.error: UHSLC's station metadata places six series several kilometers from their gauge, one of them in the open sea.
errata.lake: The station refresh moves each station to the gauge's position from another source, listed in `POSITIONS` in `src/positions.ts`. An entry applies only while UHSLC still serves the position it was written against; if UHSLC moves the station, it keeps UHSLC's position and the refresh reports the entry and fails the run until a person checks it.
errata.evidence:
| Station | UHSLC | Gauge | Off by | Source of the gauge's position |
| --- | --- | --- | --: | --- |
| Port Stanley 290A, 1964–1974 | -52.7, -57.8667 | -51.690339, -57.864931 | 112 km | PSMSL Stanley (1082), 1964–1974 |
| Port Stanley 290, 1992 on | -51.75, -57.9333 | -51.692358, -57.820514 | 10 km | PSMSL Stanley II (1796), 1992 on |
| Meulaboh 914 | 4.316667, 96.21667 | 4.1274865, 96.131854 | 23 km | IOC sea level monitoring (meul) |
| Acapulco 316 | 16.8417, -99.8517 | 16.8379333, -99.903 | 5.5 km | IOC (acap2); UHSLC's own 316A and 316B, and UNAM's records, are within 1 km of it |
| Kaumalapau 548 | 20.78, -156.9 | 20.79, -156.995 | 10 km | CO-OPS Kaumalapau Harbor (1614465); UHSLC's position is inland on Lanai |
| Chuuk 054A, 1947–1991 | 7.45368, 151.8982 | 7.44667, 151.847 | 5.7 km | NOAA's Moen Island gauge (CO-OPS 1840000); UHSLC's position is its current gauge's |

UHSLC's 290A position sits 112 km south of Stanley in the South Atlantic. slackwater-database tracks the same positions in TICON's copies of these series in openwatersio/slackwater-database#375.
